name: player_update_sub_vertical_damping
description: Player::UpdateSubVerticalDamping applies sub vertical input acceleration, +/-20 velocity clamp, sign-reversal zeroing, and neutral-input vertical damping.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this isolated helper; tier S work is deferred to a coherent Player master-type/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja has an LLIL flag-generation limitation at 0x428cb8 for the x87 fst used by the original clamp sequence; assembly was used as the source of truth for the +/-20 clamp.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x428c20 validates the subVerticalInput gate, sign-reversal localVel.y zeroing through subVerticalInputCopy, accelRate * g_Player_DeltaTime * subVerticalInputCopy integration, +/-20 localVel.y clamp, neutral throttleInputCopy guard, and time-selected idle damping rates 2 or 10.

Native smoke verifies positive and negative clamp cases with sign reversal, no-op behavior while throttleInputCopy is nonzero and vertical input is neutral, and both timed neutral damping rates selected by g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec versus primaryGunGateUntilTime.
